task: Build a compact native TypeScript and CSS “Find a field guide” search UI using the supplied fixtures/C06/fake-api.ts unchanged. The form has a labeled search input and Search button; Enter submits it. Show an initial prompt, a visible pending state while each request runs, result cards for returned guides, a useful empty state, and a clear failure state with Retry. A new search may start while a previous request is pending. Only the most recently submitted query may update the visible query/state/results; stale successes and stale failures must be ignored even though this API does not support cancellation. After a failed query Retry submits the same query again. Make loading and outcome feedback accessible, keep focus usable, and fit 320px. Use the API's built-in “cedar”, “moss”, “empty” and “fail” scenarios for checks; also test cedar followed quickly by moss, and fail followed quickly by moss. Keep this to one small local page with no backend, React or UI library. Supply setup instructions, put implementation in trial/artifact and write trial/result.json using the supplied output contract.

outputContract.note: The orchestrator supplies caseId, arm, run and trial directory. Checks use PASS, FAIL, UNVERIFIED or NOT_APPLICABLE and cite observable evidence. Never invent tool access or executed checks.
